initialPrompts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original environment art direction reference for town-rpg, a near-modern Chinese countryside youth fantasy RPG.
Create ONE full-frame landscape 16:9 image, not a collage. Consistent art bible across the series: natural real-world proportions; detailed, structurally believable environments suitable for anime-styled human characters; sophisticated stylized 3D game art with restrained painterly albedo, clean solid geometry, soft natural light, nuanced material roughness, subtle contact shadows. Medium-scale shapes and construction details are readable at ordinary gameplay distance. Plaster, wood, stone, metal and cloth must feel different. Tasteful cared-for wear, not decay. Emphasize coherent material scale and intentional composition. Avoid photorealistic photography, toy-like low-poly blocks, inflated shapes, chunky leaf blobs, heavy black outlines, hard cel bands, noisy photo textures, excessive grunge, blurry brushwork, dramatic bloom, volumetric beams, shallow depth of field, ultra-wide fisheye, HUD, captions, watermarks, split panels. Clear foreground, middle ground and background. Environment-only, no people. This is an aspirational concept illustration, not a claim of an actual game screenshot.
Scene: a small contemporary rural Chinese mountain village on a clear summer morning, viewed at natural third-person gameplay camera height about 1.7 metres, a moderate 55-degree field of view and slight downward angle, looking diagonally toward the village grocery shop and an intimate everyday square.
A modest one-storey plaster shop with grey tiled roof, believable layered eaves, slender wooden supports, recessed wooden doors and windows, a gently sagging green-and-cream fabric awning. A few useful goods crates and a wooden bench arranged naturally around the shop, not clutter. A mature broadleaf tree beside the square with asymmetrical branches, connected airy layered foliage, small gaps of sky and delicate leaf clusters, plausible trunk roots and dappled shadows. Carefully composed road-to-soil transition, shallow drainage channel, low plaster courtyard wall with stone footing and coping, sparse grass by the wall, no vegetation blocking the route. A neighbouring house and distant wooded foothills provide depth without dominating. Warm off-white plaster, muted natural wood, deep grey roof, fresh varied greens, blue-green shade, soft blue sky. The square feels lived-in, ordinary and welcoming, neither a tourist ancient town nor a fantasy village. Open walkable foreground with moderate detail and quiet surfaces. Prioritize roof/window depth, tree silhouette, ground transitions and atmospheric layered hills. Shop sign if visible reads only "杂货铺", no other legible writing.

Scene: the modest bedroom of an ordinary male high-school student in a near-modern Chinese mountain village, looking from just inside the open doorway at a bed and a simple wooden study desk near the window. Natural gameplay camera height about 1.6 metres, moderate 55-degree field of view, slight downward angle, physically credible room scale and comfortable walking space. A single bed with a wooden frame, subdued blue cotton bedding, a pillow with real volume and a few broad soft folds, not a flat slab. A structurally detailed but inexpensive wooden desk and chair, visible joinery, realistic edge thickness, a few schoolbooks, an open exercise book and a simple desk lamp. A plain wardrobe with restrained grain, believable doors and handles. Off-white plaster wall, simple baseboard, understated grey floor tiles, window frame with depth and thin pale curtain. Only modest personal belongings appropriate to a student; no luxury design, no fantasy objects, no new story clues, no photographs or posters requiring narrative interpretation. Soft morning window light falls across furniture and bedding, gentle warm bounce, cool softly defined shadow, subtly darker wall corners and furniture contact. Quiet, cared-for and personal. The wood, cloth, plaster and painted metal have clearly different restrained finishes. Focus on furniture construction, believable fabric and bounced window light, not decorative clutter. No legible text.
